title: Guardrails before bulk operations.
body: The inventory platform's CLI ships with confirm flags, batch-size caps, mandatory filters, and value-at-risk thresholds. I design for the day someone runs the wrong command against tens of thousands of racks.

proof.label: racks in the first bulk sweep

title: Real-time over stale when decisions depend on it.
body: I replaced lagging batch analytics with live computation, so operations and finance decide from the same sub-second numbers instead of last week's export.

title: Agents orchestrate tools; they don't replace them.
body: My LLM agents call the same guarded commands people use, and my AI-assisted audits pair model reasoning with human verification. That combination surfaced a data defect that had been hiding for five years.

title: Build the operating model before the headcount.
body: Before growing R&D infrastructure from 5 to 24 people, I defined onboarding, role boundaries, escalation paths, and the hiring bar for a mix of FTEs, contractors, and MSP partners.

title: Shared ownership beats escalation.
body: A long-running incident-ownership conflict ended with a shared charter across network, network-security, and infra-security teams. The same three teams partnered on 162 production changes consolidating ACL policy.
